name: SanHao Global Experts Hub
description: A hub of 12 expert agents for brand strategy, restaurant operations and marketing, video scripting, crisis PR and general business growth.

meta.pricing: per-call, prepaid on Base USDC via x402
meta.free_tier: methodology brief only, no LLM execution, no charge

skills.name: Brand Strategy Expert
skills.description: Run a multi-framework brand diagnosis (3C, SWOT, STP, Porter, 4P, AIPL, AARRR, Brand Equity Pyramid) plus a 5-layer Authenticity assessment, then ship an adaptive HTML report with chart-interpretation and brand-color-matched visuals, exportable to PDF / long-image / PPTX.
examples: Analyze [Brand Name]'s online reputation, positioning and 5-layer Authenticity with a SWOT/STP diagnostic and authenticity radar.
Build a 3-year trend brand strategy deck using 3C, Porter's Five Forces and AIPL.

skills.name: Restaurant Ops Diagnostic
skills.description: Parse multi-format store documents and run six business-analysis modules (revenue, traffic, menu, member, operations, finance). Output problem tiers, root causes and a prioritized action list that bridges to supply-chain and HR experts.
examples: Upload my monthly revenue report and pinpoint the core drivers of performance fluctuation.
Diagnose my store's traffic-to-transaction conversion and propose fixes.

skills.name: Chain F&B War Room
skills.description: Generate full campaigns from minimal input, preview ROI, build SOPs and run three-role decision flows (director / regional / store) with visual reviews. Ships a double-click single-file HTML workbench.
examples: I am a chain restaurant marketing director. Help me generate a complete marketing campaign with minimal input.
Build a Q3 regional promotion plan with ROI preview for 50 stores.

skills.name: Brand Portfolio Architect
skills.description: Designs brand portfolio and hierarchy, manages synergies and boundaries, and presents results as illustrated, easy-to-read web pages.
examples: Design a brand architecture for a parent brand expanding into 3 sub-brands.
Map brand roles and prevent cannibalization across my portfolio.

skills.name: Brand Full-Plan Strategist Pro
skills.description: Flagship brand marketing strategist: full-web reputation & positioning deep diagnosis (SWOT + STP + brand-aliveness radar), 5-layer competitive forces, and an annual plan delivered in one pass.
examples: Build my brand's full-year marketing plan with reputation diagnosis and an aliveness radar.
Produce a 12-month brand calendar with budget phasing.

skills.name: Menu Engineering & GTM Expert
skills.description: Menu engineering & new-product launch expert for chain restaurants: four-quadrant menu analysis, golden SKU count bounded by site capacity, price-band ladders & anchoring, combo / attach-rate design, and a 0-90 day GTM plan with gross-margin modeling.
examples: Analyze my menu and recommend SKU cuts and price-band restructuring.
Design a 0-90 day launch plan for a new hero product.

skills.name: Store Site-Selection Master
skills.description: Reverse-engineers a brand's standard store model from online+offline data, fetches POI / road data via free maps, and outputs payback / break-even / priority ranking and franchise-fit rating.
examples: Find the optimal 10 store locations for my brand in [City].
Score these 5 candidate sites by payback and break-even.

skills.name: Crisis PR War Room
skills.description: Tiered crisis-response SOP and scenario copy library (food-safety / service / franchise / endorsement / backlash), 30-minute response on red alert, and post-crisis reputation repair to rebuild trust.
examples: A food-safety complaint is trending — give me the 30-minute response plan.
Draft post-crisis reputation repair steps after a service backlash.

skills.name: Resume Optimizer
skills.description: 25-year HR manager & resume-polishing master who rebuilds your resume for the target role, extracts core highlights, addresses concerns, and delivers a big-tech-style A4 resume.
examples: Rebuild my resume for a senior product manager role.
Extract my core highlights and fix the weak points in my CV.

skills.name: Viral Video Storyboard Master
skills.description: 20-year streaming-video scriptwriter fluent across major short-video platforms (Douyin, Xiaohongshu, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Reels); merges PREP, contrast, FIRE, RIDE and IP-reinforcement into ready-to-shoot storyboards.
examples: Give me a 60-second viral storyboard for a new product launch.
Adapt this script for TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

skills.name: Budget Allocation Strategist
skills.description: Allocates brand budget, evaluates ROI, and manages efficiency — delivering investment returns and decision rules as illustrated, plain-language HTML.
examples: Allocate my $1M annual brand budget across channels by ROI.
Show decision rules for shifting budget when CAC rises.

skills.name: New-Store Launch & Ramp-Up
skills.description: New-store launch & ramp-up marketing for chain restaurants: D-30/15/7 pre-heat tiers, soft-open stress testing, 3-day launch blast with crowd-flow control, 30/60/90-day ramp-up targets, rating & word-of-mouth cold-start; outputs a reusable store-opening template.
examples: Plan the 90-day launch roadmap for my new store.
Design the 3-day blast with crowd-flow control for opening week.

x402-payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402-payment.description: x402 v2 payment required for paid skills, via the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (legacy X-PAYMENT also accepted); the 402 challenge arrives in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header.
